title: AS2 clip events onEnterFrame onLoad onUnload tests
description: Tests for MovieClip clip events: mc.onEnterFrame = fn, mc.onLoad = fn, mc.onUnload = fn, mc.onMouseMove/Down/Up = fn, mc.onPress = fn, mc.onRelease/ReleaseOutside = fn, mc.onRollOver/Out = fn, mc.onDragOver/Out = fn. These attach to instances, not frames.
